_comment: Shared contract between postprocess-text.ts and kindle_postprocess.py. Both test suites assert against this file, so a change to either implementation alone breaks its own tests. formatText cases compare formatContentChunks(chunks, {detectHeadings: false}) against '\n\n'.join(r['text'] for r in normalize_content(chunks)).
